summary: Rentokil Initial plc (RTO) filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Rafael Carrasco as CEO, North America, effective August 3, 2026. Carrasco joins from WM, where he led healthcare solutions and strategy, including integrating Stericycle. The current interim CEO, Alain Moffroid, will remain in a support role through 2027. No financial terms, premiums, or advisor were disclosed. This is a routine senior management appointment, not a forced departure or activist-driven change. Watch for operational updates as the new CEO assumes leadership.
